exposure: Length of first stage of labor
Length of second stage of labor
cohort: 54 febrile patients and 306 nonfebrile controls between 36 0/7 and 42 0/7 gestational weeks who entered spontaneous or induced active labor
finding: Several noninfectious factors, including nulligravidity, prolonged labor stages, prolonged membrane rupture, increased vaginal exams, oxytocin use, and meperidine use, were associated with intrapartum fever.
